confirmationProtocol.acceptance: Weighted lower95 above zero, certified gain positive, no opponent drop above2pp, no more invalid games

confirmation.primaryMetric: Paired matchup points; invalid games count as zero
confirmation.interval: Approximate 95% normal interval, clustered by matchup and stratified by opponent

archetypes.scope: Exploratory reference-based archetype grouping; descriptive, unadjusted for opponent mix; no new candidate selection or per-archetype strength certificate

classifier.method: Archetype-IDF-weighted main-deck multiset Jaccard, closest recipe per family; ambiguous or unsupported decks remain Unclassified

diagnosticReproduction.sampling: Four distinct losing matchups per lowest-rate classified learner group with sufficient data

pairReservation.purpose: One independently frozen activation-cost candidate confirmation only; never training or selection

historicalControl.scope: Historical v3 behavior on frozen v3-confirmation tasks, both activated-cost projections disabled

limitations: Independent strength gain was not established; the selected candidate is not promoted.
Approximate normal confidence interval clustered by matchup and stratified by opponent.
Real human deck lists with simulated bot opponents; no live-human win-rate claim.
Certified opponents use the current default scorer in both arms; historical controls apply to the learner and frozen v3.
Gross immediate memory spending excludes refunds, triggered responses and deferred payments; unknown costs stay uncertain.
Eight invalid games in each arm on matching tasks: seven legacy-opponent evolution rejections and one worker timeout.
Archetype labels cover 53.4375% of learner exposures and rates are unadjusted for opponent mix.
Diagnostic scores are rounded to three decimals and show only the chosen action plus top-three alternatives; selected losses do not prove counterfactual wins.
Concurrent local validation competed for CPU during part of confirmation; the test-type compiler was stopped and subsequently rerun after game evaluation.
No MCTS, planner or model API calls were used for this experiment.
